definition: Top-level ODPC portfolio container for catalog metadata and a unified nodes array.
doUseFor: Catalog or portfolio containers
Domain, audience, ownership, and lifecycle scope
Grouping reusable nodes
Pointing to an ODPG or other graph implementation through metadata.graph

definition: Lightweight catalog reference to a data product that identifies the product and points to the authoritative product definition through productModel.
doUseFor: Listing data products in a catalog
Search, filtering, browsing, and prioritization
Referencing ODPS or another authoritative product model
doNotUseFor: Defining access, SLA, pricing, support, or technical interfaces
Connecting products to use cases directly

definition: Demand-side ODPC object describing why data is needed, who needs it, what decision or process it supports, and what outcome is expected.
doUseFor: Business, operational, analytical, policy, or user needs
Demand capture and portfolio planning
Explaining expected outcomes and data needs
doNotUseFor: Strategic objectives that own KPI targets
Explicit product relationships or graph edges

definition: Outcome-oriented ODPC object describing a higher-level business, operational, policy, or strategic objective that use cases and data products can contribute to.
doUseFor: Strategic, policy, business, or operational outcomes
Portfolio-level value management
Objective-level KPI targets and measurement
doNotUseFor: Graph relationships between objectives and products

definition: Key performance indicator nested inside BusinessObjective.kpis to measure progress toward a business objective.
doUseFor: Measuring progress toward a BusinessObjective
Capturing baseline and target values
Objective-level performance management

definition: Observed market, operational, user, technology, policy, competitive, quality, usage, risk, or gap indicator that may create demand for use cases, data products, or product improvements.
doUseFor: Capturing evidence of demand, risk, opportunity, quality, usage, or gaps
AI-assisted market and portfolio intelligence
Prioritization and planning inputs
doNotUseFor: Direct relationships to products or use cases

definition: Top-level ODPC object for a reusable business, organizational, data, or technical domain.
doUseFor: Cataloging reusable domains
Classifying the nature and accountable owner of a domain
Pointing to an authoritative domain source
doNotUseFor: Relationships or edges to other nodes

definition: Top-level ODPC object for a reusable dataset resource with discovery metadata for release, freshness, sensitivity, and access.
doUseFor: Cataloging reusable datasets
Filtering by freshness, sensitivity, and access expectation
Pointing to an authoritative dataset source
doNotUseFor: Embedding distributions, schemas, or API contracts

definition: Top-level ODPC object for a reusable service interface with its interface style, endpoint, and access expectation.
doUseFor: Cataloging APIs as reusable portfolio objects
Discovering an API endpoint and contract reference
doNotUseFor: Embedding an API contract or security scheme

definition: Top-level ODPC object for a reusable governance, compliance, security, or quality policy with its applicability and enforcement summary.
doUseFor: Cataloging policy categories and lifecycle
Discovering effective periods and enforcement approach
Pointing to an authoritative policy source
doNotUseFor: Embedding policy rules, duties, targets, or governed-node relationships

definition: Top-level ODPC object for a reusable workflow with its purpose, trigger, and definition version.
doUseFor: Cataloging reusable workflows
Filtering workflows by purpose and initiation mechanism
Pointing to an authoritative workflow source
doNotUseFor: Embedding workflow steps, participants, dependencies, or input/output relationships

definition: Top-level ODPC object for a reusable AI, automation, human, or organizational actor with an explicit autonomy level.
doUseFor: Cataloging reusable agents and actors
Discovering agent autonomy and authoritative agent definitions
doNotUseFor: Embedding credentials, skills, tools, prompts, or run-time configuration

definition: Top-level ODPC v1.1 object for an accountable AI product with business purpose, governance, evaluation, operations, and external implementation references.
doUseFor: Cataloging a governed AI product
Describing product-level accountability and evaluation
Pointing to externally governed technical components
doNotUseFor: Embedding prompts, weights, credentials, runtime configuration, or deployment configuration

definition: Top-level ODPC object for a reusable business, data, technical, or AI capability with maturity metadata for gap analysis.
doUseFor: Cataloging reusable capabilities
Capability maturity and gap analysis
Pointing to an authoritative capability definition
doNotUseFor: Capability decomposition or relationships to enabling assets

definition: Top-level ODPC object for a reusable strategic opportunity with assessment, impact, and time-horizon metadata.
doUseFor: Cataloging opportunities for portfolio planning
Assessing confidence, potential value, urgency, and realization horizon
Pointing to an authoritative opportunity definition
doNotUseFor: Relationships to objectives, capabilities, products, or other nodes
